Title: Azure Boards - Delivery Plans 2.0 is now in preview

Body.Content:
Azure Boards previously relied on extensions and integrations to provide timeline and roadmap capabilities spanning teams and projects. We're announcing that Delivery Plans 2.0 brings these capabilities to the core product, and it's now available for public preview.

Other key features to enhance the overall user experience are now available:

Azure Boards

  • Removed items on the Work Items page
  • Delivery Plans (Preview)

Azure Pipelines

  • Improve YAML conversion in the classic build designer

Azure Test Plans

  • New Test Plans page general availability
